target.title: fix(provider-error): keep error body truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where provider error bodies truncated at the UTF-16 length limit could split an emoji or other surrogate-pair character, rendering a broken replacement glyph in error messages shown to users.

## Why This Change Was Made

The raw `String.prototype.slice()` call at the truncation boundary does not account for UTF-16 surrogate pairs. Replacing it with the shared `truncateUtf16Safe` helper ensures that multi-code-unit characters are either kept whole or dropped entirely, never halved.

## User Impact

Provider error messages that include emoji, CJK ideographs, or other non-BMP characters remain well-formed when the error body exceeds the 4000-character display limit.

## Evidence

- 6/6 tests passed, including two new cases:
  - emoji that fits entirely within the 4000-char limit is preserved
  - emoji that would be split by a raw 4000-char slice is dropped whole instead of emitting a lone surrogate
- Existing behavior for ASCII-only and shorter error bodies is unchanged.

---

**Updated: Path-specific real-behavior evidence (2026-07-17)**

Ran actual path tests via `npx vitest run packages/ai/src/utils/provider-error.test.ts`:
- "truncates long error bodies without splitting UTF-16 surrogate pairs" — emoji fully inside 4000-char boundary preserved
- "drops an emoji from the truncation boundary instead of splitting it" — emoji at the slice boundary is dropped whole, no lone surrogate emitted
- All 6/6 tests passed on the actual formatProviderError function

**Test result**: ✓ 6/6 tests passed

---

## Terminal Evidence

The following terminal output demonstrates the fix in action — the `truncateUtf16Safe` helper at the 4000-unit boundary:

```
=== UTF-16 Safety Evidence ===
Scenario: error body at boundary length with trailing emoji

Input: 3999 ASCII chars + 😱
Input length (UTF-16): 4001
Input length (chars): 4000

--- BUG: String.prototype.slice(0, 4000) ---
Result length: 4000
Last char code: 0xd83d
Ends with lone surrogate: true
Valid output: NO — lone surrogate!

--- FIX: truncateUtf16Safe(body, 4000) ---
Result length: 3999
Last char: A
Last char code: 0x41
Ends with lone surrogate: false
Valid output: YES — clean truncation!

=== Verification ===
Bug: lone surrogate at boundary = true
Fix: truncation is surrogate-safe = true
Status: ✅ PASS
```
